summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Global AI Law Tracker. All 19 backend API endpoints passed (100% success rate). All frontend features tested and working: theme toggle, interactive world map with country panels, filters, law details, timeline, comparison, and AI assistant with streaming responses.

design_issues.issue: Console warnings about missing DialogTitle for accessibility (shadcn/ui best practice)
design_issues.impact: Accessibility warning only, no functional impact
design_issues.recommendation: Wrap DialogTitle with VisuallyHidden component or add aria-describedby

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/stats returns 26 laws, 17 jurisdictions, timeline, region_status
Backend: GET /api/laws with all filters (search, region, status, category, country, year_min, year_max, sort)
Backend: GET /api/laws/{id} returns full law details with key_provisions, sources, related
Backend: GET /api/laws/{id} returns 404 for invalid ID
Backend: GET /api/countries returns 49 countries with maturity levels
Backend: GET /api/countries/France returns de-duplicated laws including EU AI Act
Backend: GET /api/countries/China returns 3 laws
Backend: GET /api/countries/{name} returns 404 for invalid country
Backend: GET /api/meta returns all filter metadata (regions, statuses, categories, countries, year range)
Backend: POST /api/chat streams SSE response with refs, deltas, and done events (223 delta events received)
Backend: GET /api/chat/history/{session_id} returns stored messages
Frontend: Page loads correctly with header, hero, and navigation
Frontend: Theme toggle switches between light/dark mode and persists in localStorage
Frontend: Stats dashboard displays 4 KPI cards (total laws, jurisdictions, enacted, proposed)
Frontend: World map renders with proper country coloring based on maturity
Frontend: Map mode toggle switches between Maturity and Status legends
Frontend: Map legend displays correctly for both modes
Frontend: Clicking a country (USA) opens country panel with 6 laws listed
Frontend: Browse tab search filter works (EU AI Act search returned 1 result)
Frontend: Browse tab region filter works (Asia returned 9 laws)
Frontend: Browse tab status filter works (Enacted returned 9 laws)
Frontend: Browse tab reset filters works (restored all 26 laws)
Frontend: Law card click opens law detail dialog with sources
Frontend: Timeline tab displays chronological view
Frontend: Compare tab allows country selection (added USA)
Frontend: AI Assistant panel displays with 4 suggestion chips
Frontend: AI Assistant suggestion chip triggers streaming response
Frontend: AI Assistant manual input works with streaming (4 total messages after 2 interactions)
Frontend: All navigation tabs functional (Explore, Browse, Timeline, Compare, Assistant)
